create_xcodec_config: create an XcodecConfig instance with default acoustic and semantic model configurations
create_xcodec_config_custom: create an XcodecConfig with custom target bandwidths, codebook size, and sample rate parameters
create_xcodec_config_from_dict: create an XcodecConfig initialized from a dictionary of acoustic and semantic model config kwargs
read_xcodec_config_properties: read XcodecConfig computed properties like frame_rate, hop_length, codebook_nbits, and hidden_size
build_xcodec_model_from_config: build an XcodecModel from an XcodecConfig instance with random weights
